 Order

The first respondent is directed to file a statement indicating specifically as to whether there is any standard prescribed for well water in terms of the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder.
The first respondent shall also state in the statement as to whether there exist any restrictions in the matter of selling the well water in terms of the aforesaid statutory provisions.
There will be an interim order as prayed for.

Sd/-
